<panel>
	<parent>Panel</parent>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<file line="">lua/vgui/dsizetocontents.lua</file>
	<description>
		A helper panel that will automatically resize itself to fit all its children using <page>Panel:SizeToChildren</page>.
	</description>
	<overrides>
		<page>Panel:Init</page>
		<page>Panel:PerformLayout</page>
	</overrides>
</panel>
